## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Burj Khalifa, 1 Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Blvd - Downtown Dubai.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dubai is known as the 'City of Superlatives' (what else would you expect from a place where the police drive Lamborghinis?). That unsurpassed sense of grandiosity is on its finest display in Dubai Mall - the largest mall in the world, attached to the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building.
>
> This combo ticket lets you soak up that impressiveness with access to the 124th floor of the Burj, and a visit to the shark and crocodile-filled Dubai Aquarium.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €92.45. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 101 ratings and 42 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
